summary: The lane guard's probes are bounded, its loaders never import without a safe cache prefix, its imports cannot be shadowed, its tests discriminate

tests.command:
bash tests/test-epic-goal-stop.sh
bash -c 'bash tests/test-epic-goal-stop.sh && bash tests/test-native-points.sh'
bash -c '[ -f scripts/compound-v-scope-check.py ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/compound-v-scope-check.py --selftest'
bash -c '[ -f scripts/compound-v-validate-manifest.py ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/compound-v-validate-manifest.py --selftest'
bash -c '[ -f tests/test-lane-guard.sh ] || exit 0; bash tests/test-lane-guard.sh'
bash -c 'for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; echo all-tests-ok'
